lines.en: I trample the glowing gravel
Ash sifts out of my joints

lines.zh: 我走一步，地面就裂一道
lines.en: Each step splits a line in the ground

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的风很烫
lines.en: The wind in the basalt deltas is scorching
My legs are two pillars of stone
I walk slowly, and no one hurries me
Heat rolls up around me
I crush a piece of pumice
The heat warps my shadow
I travel along the ridge
Nothing here but stone and me
The ground smokes where I pass
I lower my head and skirt the lava well
Every step is heavy and long

lines.zh: 我身上挂着凝固的岩渣
lines.en: Cooled slag hangs off my body

lines.zh: 我走到火最旺的地方去
lines.en: I head for where the fire burns brightest

lines.zh: 我站着，像一块立起来的岩
lines.en: I stand like a raised slab of rock
The hot wind passes, and I do not move
The seams in my body still glow

lines.zh: 一百八十点，我知道自己结实
lines.en: One hundred eighty points, I know I am tough
I wait for the ash to settle

lines.zh: 灰落在我背上，积了一层
lines.en: Ash settles on my back in a layer

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的火，从我的斧刃上过。
lines.en: Basalt Delta fire runs down my axe.
The fire here never goes out
I do not sweat, I only smoke
The cliff beside me is older than I am
I have no wish to do anything

lines.zh: 玄武岩的灰，落在我肩上。
lines.en: Basalt dust settles on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 脚下是滚烫的，我习惯了
lines.en: Underfoot is scalding, and I am used to it

lines.zh: 我把手按在地上，地就静了
lines.en: I press a hand down and the ground quiets
I watch the lava with open eyes

lines.zh: 你最好别在这儿待太久
lines.en: You had best not linger here

lines.zh: 你不该站在这片石头上
lines.en: You should not stand on this stone
I am two heads taller than you

lines.zh: 我这一身，是一层层凝起来的
lines.en: I am built layer by layer
You carry no ash on you
Do not go near the lava mouth

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块小石子
lines.en: I look at you like a small pebble

lines.zh: 这里的热会先把你烤干
lines.en: The heat here will dry you out first
I blink slowly
Step back, I will not chase

lines.zh: 我认得这片地的每道裂缝
lines.en: I know every crack in this ground
That thing in your hand is bright
Few stand across from me
The rock on me cracked
I take a small step back

lines.zh: 这点伤要多打几下才行
lines.en: It would take more hits than that
Ash spills out of the wound
A small chunk of my shoulder rock breaks off.
You can move me, not bad
I do not shout, stone does not shout
Rubble falls from my elbow.
This scar will last
You will have to do it again

lines.zh: 你举着的那个，我看不懂
lines.en: I do not understand what you hold up

lines.zh: 我不吃这些，你自己留着
lines.en: I do not eat this, keep it
Come closer, let me smell it
There is nothing edible on this land
Set the thing on the stone
I have no need, but I will not drive you off
The heat will ruin that thing
What do you mean to do with that
That warmth is nothing next to lava.

lines.zh: 没见过这种东西长在石头上
lines.en: Never saw such a thing grow on stone
My palm is far bigger than it
You need not hand it to me

lines.zh: 我的指头一合，就成粉了。
lines.en: My fingers close and it turns to dust.
Leave it, I will watch over it

lines.zh: 我的耐心只够看一会儿
lines.en: My patience lasts only a short look
You had better take it back

lines.zh: 你撞上了岩壁一样的东西
lines.en: You hit something like a cliff
I barely shifted
That was nothing to me
Step aside, stone does not yield

lines.zh: 热从我身上传到你那儿了
lines.en: Heat passed from me to you
I lift a foot and you retreat

lines.zh: 你的骨头比岩灰硬一点
lines.en: Your bones are a little harder than ash
Do not lean on me, I am hot
I turn slightly aside
Touch me and you learn my weight

lines.zh: 这片石滩上只有我一个
lines.en: I am the only one on this stone shore
When kin meet, we compare size first

lines.zh: 两个我站在一块，这里就太挤
lines.en: Two of me would crowd this place
No hurry, the fire still burns

lines.zh: 同类的声音像石头的摩擦
lines.en: My kind's voice is stone grinding stone
Walking together, the ground would give
I do not seek a mate, I keep this ground

lines.zh: 如果来了一个，我会站住
lines.en: If one comes, I will stand my ground
We could watch the lava flow together
That waits until the stone grows thicker
I pin it under my palm
So light I hardly grasp it

lines.zh: 我捡起来，又落了一手灰
lines.en: I pick it up, and ash falls from my hand
It heats up in my hand
I bury it in a crack in the stone

lines.zh: 东西掉在这里很快就坏
lines.en: Things dropped here spoil fast

lines.zh: 我捏起一块烫手的碎石。
lines.en: I pinch up a hot shard of stone.

lines.zh: 这比不上我脚边的石子
lines.en: It is worth less than the pebbles at my feet
I moved this basalt aside.
I leave it, perhaps you will come back for it
You trampled my stone ground

lines.zh: 我转头的时候，你已经进来了
lines.en: When I turned, you were already inside
This hot ground is mine to keep
I stand between the basalt columns
You came close, now it is hard to leave
I have lifted my foot
The fire here helps me

lines.zh: 你的脚印留在了热地上。
lines.en: Your footprints stay on the hot ground.
There is no cover in this stretch
I look at you and turn around slowly

lines.zh: 玄武岩的刽子手，比同类壮。
lines.en: A basalt executioner, sturdier than kin.
The way you retreat is toward the lava

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落处，石头开裂。
lines.en: Stone cracks where my foot lands.
Heat climbs from the ground to your feet

lines.zh: 你每跳一下，我就近一点
lines.en: Each time you hop, I am nearer

lines.zh: 这片地上的裂缝我全知道
lines.en: I know every crack in this ground
You cannot go around me
My shadow blocks the way
A little more and there is nowhere left
My hand has stayed raised
I drive a fist into the ground

lines.zh: 石头跟着我的手一起来
lines.en: Stone comes with my hand
That left a crater
One stamp and you stagger
The heat arrives first, the fist after
This strike has no flourish
My palm lands on you
You slide across the ground
A few chunks of slag fall off me
That will keep you thinking

lines.zh: 我从冷却的岩层里站起来
lines.en: I rise out of the cooling rock

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲多了一个影子
lines.en: One more shadow in the basalt deltas

lines.zh: 熔岩的光从我的缝里透出。
lines.en: Lava light shows through my cracks.
This hot ground has a keeper again

lines.zh: 我比另一个刽子手更结实
lines.en: I am the sturdier of the two executioners

lines.zh: 我先看了看脚下的熔岩
lines.en: I look first at the lava underfoot
The stone has finished growing on me

lines.zh: 我站起来时地响了一声
lines.en: The ground groaned as I stood
The fire here knows me
I slowly raise a hand
Fire means little to me

lines.zh: 落地时我整个人陷进石里
lines.en: I sink into the stone as I land

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，冒着白汽
lines.en: Water hits me and white steam rises
The blast lifted the rock layers

lines.zh: 飞来的东西嵌进了我的岩缝
lines.en: Something flying lodged in my seams
This force is greater than any I have met

lines.zh: 我靠热活着，可热也会淡
lines.en: I live on heat, and heat fades too

lines.zh: 雷击在我身上，像敲石头
lines.en: Lightning strikes me like a hammer on stone

lines.zh: 虚空里没有熔岩，我冷得发僵
lines.en: No lava in the void, and I stiffen with cold
